findings.recommended_review: Agree the reporting basis with the project controls lead: approved usage only, with pending draws disclosed separately as commitments against the reserve.
findings.recommended_action: Restate the register to show approved balance, pending draws and resulting forecast balance as three separate lines.

findings.finding_description: Forecast to Complete is -$200,000, a negative value. A negative FTC implies the package expects to recover cost already incurred, which usually indicates an over-accrual, a credit posted to the wrong period, or a forecast plug.
findings.recommended_review: Reconcile actual cost to invoices and accruals for this package and confirm whether a credit or reversal is expected.
findings.recommended_action: Restate FTC to zero or to a supported positive value and disclose any expected credit separately.

findings.recommended_action: No financial adjustment required; raise a data-quality ticket against the originating register.
